'''Freighter M226''' was a [[Temple-class heavy freighter|''Temple''-class heavy freighter]] that served as part of the secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] known as the [[Perlemian Haul]].<ref name="PH" />
